name: Sgt. R. Dacted
quote: I read Fish News every morning. I am not permitted to say why.

name: P. Remonition
quote: Fish News reported my promotion two days before I applied for it. I have since stopped applying for things.

name: Cpl. N. O'Comment
quote: I was quoted accurately. I've asked them to stop.

name: D. Brief
quote: The coverage of the training exercise was thorough, balanced, and filed before the exercise began.

name: E. Scape
quote: Mr Whatney interviewed me for four hours. I was only in the room for twenty minutes.

name: Wg Cdr. S. Pinn
quote: I declined to comment on Fish News, and Fish News has already published it.

name: D. Tained
quote: Mr Whatney told me he had covered the fall of Rome, and that my disciplinary hearing was comparable in scale. I found this reassuring, briefly.

name: Gp Capt. B. Ias
quote: Genuinely balanced reporting. Both sides of the story were Chunce's.

name: A. Pology
quote: I asked Fish News for a correction. They issued a longer version of the original.

name: WO I. Gnored
quote: Fish News has never once contacted my commanding officer for comment. My commanding officer has asked me to pass that on.

name: H. Earsay
quote: I was described as a source close to the matter. I was the matter.

name: L. E. Gal
quote: Reliable, consistent, and legally distinct from defamation.

name: U. R. Wrong
quote: My mother reads it. She has not spoken to me since the March edition.

name: FS C. C. Teavee
quote: Fish News arrived at the scene before the incident. We are still reviewing the footage.

name: I. N. Cognito
quote: I told Mr Whatney I'd rather not be named. He has addressed me by my initials ever since, loudly, in corridors.

name: T. Ruth
quote: The article about me was largely accurate, which I have found to be the most upsetting part.

name: Sqn Ldr. N. Quiry
quote: Mr Whatney assured me he was present at Agincourt. He then asked where the car park was.

name: O. B. Fuscate
quote: I would describe their reporting as operationally adjacent to the truth.

name: E. Cho
quote: An important voice. Frequently several important voices, all of them Chunce's.

name: D. D. Bitt
quote: I have subscribed to Fish News three times. I have never subscribed to Fish News.

name: C. W.
quote: The finest publication in human history, and I would know, I have read all of it. Some of it was on clay tablets. I CARVED THE TABLETS.
